claims.claim: `promptarena` and `packc` each provide a shell completion feature
Completions suggest commands, flags, and dynamic values such as scenario names and providers
Command and subcommand completion is available
Flag names complete with a `--` prefix
`--scenario` lists scenarios from `config.arena.yaml`
`--provider` lists configured providers
run --roles has no completion
`--region` suggests prompt regions
`--format` offers the output formats json, junit, markdown, csv
`--section` lists config sections for `config-inspect`
`--template` lists available project templates for `init`
The bash completion directory is `~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions`, and bash-completion loads files from it
`promptarena completion bash` prints a bash completion script
`packc completion bash` prints a bash completion script
Sourcing the generated files loads completion in the current shell
Writing to `/etc/bash_completion.d/promptarena` with `sudo promptarena completion bash > ...` succeeds, which requires the redirect to run as root
`packc completion bash` writes a script usable under `/etc/bash_completion.d/packc`
`command -v promptarena` detects the binary on PATH
`source <(promptarena completion bash)` loads bash completion from stdout
`source <(packc completion bash)` loads bash completion from stdout
`promptarena completion zsh` writes a zsh completion script
`packc completion zsh` writes a zsh completion script
zsh loads a completion for `promptarena` from a file named `_promptarena` in an fpath directory
`fpath=(~/.zsh/completions $fpath)` adds that directory to zsh's function path
`autoload -Uz compinit && compinit` initialises zsh completion
`promptarena completion zsh` output can be placed at `${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/promptarena/_promptarena` for Oh My Zsh
`packc completion zsh` output can be placed at `${ZSH_CUSTOM:-~/.oh-my-zsh/custom}/plugins/packc/_packc` for Oh My Zsh
`promptarena completion fish` writes a fish completion script
`packc completion fish` writes a fish completion script
Fish loads completions automatically from `~/.config/fish/completions/`
`promptarena completion powershell` writes a PowerShell completion script
`packc completion powershell` writes a PowerShell completion script
Dot-sourcing `./promptarena.ps1` loads completion in the current session
`promptarena completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression` loads completion in the profile
`packc completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression` loads completion in the profile
The demo Docker image has completions pre-configured
The Alpine package `bash-completion` is installable with `apk add --no-cache bash-completion`
`promptarena completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/promptarena` works inside a Dockerfile RUN step
`packc completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/packc` works inside a Dockerfile RUN step
`/etc/profile.d/bash_completion.sh` exists on Alpine after installing bash-completion and sourcing it loads completions
`promptarena r<Tab>` completes to `promptarena run`
`promptarena run --sc<Tab>` completes to `--scenario`
`promptarena run --scenario <Tab>` lists scenario names from the config (example output basic-chat, edge-cases, multi-turn)
`promptarena run --provider <Tab>` offers openai, anthropic, google, mock
`promptarena config-inspect --section` accepts prompts, providers, scenarios, tools, selfplay, judges, defaults, validation
`promptarena init --template` offers quick-start, customer-support, code-assistant, multimodal, mcp-integration
`which promptarena` reports the installed binary
`promptarena completion bash | head -20` prints the start of the completion script
`brew install bash-completion@2` is the Homebrew package for bash completion on macOS
`apt install bash-completion` is the package on Ubuntu/Debian
`exec $SHELL` reloads the shell
Dynamic completions (scenarios, providers) need a valid config.arena.yaml in the current or a parent directory, and return empty results without one
`ls config.arena.yaml` checks for the config file in the current directory
`promptarena __complete run --scenario ""` is the hidden completion entry point that lists scenarios
Link target /arena/how-to/setup/installation/ exists
Link target /arena/reference/cli-commands exists
